exposure: Surgical resection of retrocervical deep infiltrating endometriosis
History of digestive resection with ileostomy
outcome: Thinning of the median posterior uterine isthmus
cohort: Forty-two endometriosis patients who underwent surgical resection of retrocervical deep infiltrating endometriosis at Croix-Rousse University Hospital between 2016 and 2020 and had available preoperative and postoperative MRI images.
finding: Surgical resection of retrocervical deep infiltrating endometriosis is associated with a significant decrease in the sagittal thickness of the median posterior uterine isthmus postoperatively.
mod_finding: Four pregnancies among the patients were carried to term with cesarean delivery.
